text:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up: can we permit aggressive 4-bit (int4) on low-risk endpoints at night/weekend? Need clear safety boundaries and ops handoff.
ajay: Strong +1 to clear boundaries. Main engineering risk is flip-flopping between precisions causing cache thrash and perf variability. Suggest cooldown window + distributed decision lock.
lucas: FYI my reranker sweep showed ~2.8-3.5% hit on top1 surrogate when forcing int4 for certain prompts. Synthetic only, but alarming enough to gate.
sophie: What about per-route precision policies with explicit min_quality and an opt-in rollout mode. Prototype schema:```
precision_policy:
  default: int8
  routes:
    /api/search: fp16
    /api/typeahead: int4(offpeak)
  hysteresis_ms: 300
  min_quality:
    /api/typeahead: 0.935
```
maria: Yep. Also require an explicit fallback chain config per-route, e.g. [int4, int8, fp16], and a revert condition tied to measured deg_score.
ajay: Canary first: route 1% traffic to int4, measure latency, top1 proxy, perplexity delta. If any metric crosses threshold, revert. Deploy tooling should accept `--canary=1%`.
deploy-bot: rollout flag `quant.experimental` created for infra. Use it with canaries.
oncall: Add telemetry hooks to SRE dashboard: `quant.deg_score`, `quant.lat_p95`, `quant.fallbacks`, `quant.canary_traffic` and an alert when deg_score > 0.04 for 5m.
lucas: We should capture samples that cause the highest deltas for offline QA (store up to 1k examples per revert event).
sophie: Client-driven negotiation could help product endpoints: propose header `Precision-Negotiate: prefer=int4;min_quality=0.95`. Runtime can accept or override based on route policy.
ajay: Important: never allow client-specified lowbit on immutable routes (payments, auth). Add `immutable: true` flag to route configs.
maria: Implementation note: runtime decision flow per request: 1) read route policy -> 2) consult cached quant profile for model sha -> 3) check live telemetry (deg_score, pool health) -> 4) acquire cooldown lock -> 5) apply precision or fallback and increment `quant.fallbacks`. Make it atomic.
ajay: Also add a small budget controller per-GPU-pool to limit concurrent int4 in pools where numerical instability was observed under load.
oncall: +1. Add a `pool.safe_concurrent_lowbit` config.
sophie: Profile storage: version quant profiles and bind by model SHA. Rollbacks should swap profile pointers (profile_id) so we don't re-deploy models during a revert.
lucas: I'll run extended evals across reranker/open-domain and adversarial prompts to find worst-case regressions and report back numbers.
maria: API thoughts: endpoints to manage profiles and attach to routes: `POST /v1/quant_profiles` (body: model_sha, profile_version, bitwidth, scales, min_quality), `GET /v1/quant_profiles/:id`, `PATCH /v1/routes/:name` to attach profile id.
sophie: Sample negotiation headers sketch:```
# request
Precision-Negotiate: prefer=int4;min_quality=0.95;timeout_ms=50
# response
Precision-Applied: int8;reason="quality_guard"
```
ajay: Ops playbook suggestion: auto-revert route to int8 if deg_score > 0.04 for 5 consecutive minutes, post incident to #eng-oncall and #product, and attach the top 500 sample requests to the ticket.
maria: Action items: 1) I will update the RFC with per-route schema + canary plan + playbook, 2) Sophie will draft route config with `immutable` + fallback chain, 3) Lucas runs eval sweep and produces numbers, 4) Ajay will prototype the cooldown/lock and pool budget logic.
deploy-bot: Created INF-2109 to automate canary rollouts and INF-2110 for profile API work.
maria: Conservative defaults: no lowbit enabled by default; opt-in per-route with explicit QA + canary. :thumbsup:
